WITH smoker_concepts AS (
  SELECT concept_id, concept_name
  FROM omop.concept
  WHERE domain_id = 'Observation'
    AND vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED'
    AND concept_class_id = 'Clinical Finding'
    AND (
      LOWER(concept_name) IN ('smoker', 'cigarette smoker')
      OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%cigarette smoker%'
      OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%cigar smoker%'
      OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%pipe smoker%'
      OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%tobacco smoker%'
      OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%smokes tobacco daily%'
      OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%heavy tobacco smoker%'
      OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%light tobacco smoker%'
      OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%occasional tobacco smoker%'
      OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%chain smoker%'
    )
    AND LOWER(concept_name) NOT LIKE '%ex-%'
    AND LOWER(concept_name) NOT LIKE '%former%'
    AND LOWER(concept_name) NOT LIKE '%non-smoker%'
    AND LOWER(concept_name) NOT LIKE '%non smoker%'
    AND LOWER(concept_name) NOT LIKE '%household%'
    AND LOWER(concept_name) NOT LIKE '%family%'
    AND LOWER(concept_name) NOT LIKE '%maternal%'
    AND LOWER(concept_name) NOT LIKE '%mother%'
    AND LOWER(concept_name) NOT LIKE '%unknown%'
), smokers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT o.person_id
  FROM omop.observation o
  JOIN smoker_concepts sc ON o.observation_concept_id = sc.concept_id
), cancer_desc AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 443392
)
SELECT TOP 20
  c.concept_name AS cancer_diagnosis,
  COUNT(*) AS condition_occurrences,
  COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS patients
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
JOIN smokers s ON co.person_id = s.person_id
JOIN cancer_desc cd ON co.condition_concept_id = cd.concept_id
JOIN omop.concept c ON co.condition_concept_id = c.concept_id
WHERE co.condition_start_date >= DATEADD(year, -2, CAST(GETDATE() AS date))
GROUP BY c.concept_name
ORDER BY patients DESC, condition_occurrences DESC, c.concept_name

arguments.sql_query:
WITH smokers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT o.person_id
  FROM omop.observation o
  WHERE o.observation_concept_id IN (
    903654, -- Tobacco or its derivatives user
    903657, -- Cigarette smoker
    903655, -- Electronic cigarette smoker
    903659, -- Light cigarette smoker
    903661, -- Heavy cigarette smoker
    903664, -- Cigar smoker
    2101895, -- Current tobacco smoker
    903660, -- Moderate cigarette smoker
    903666, -- Smokeless tobacco user
    903663, -- Pipe smoker
    2101896, -- Current smokeless tobacco user
    903665, -- Hookah smoker
    903658, -- Trivial cigarette smoker
    903662  -- Very heavy cigarette smoker
  )
), cancer_desc AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 443392 -- Malignant neoplastic disease
)
SELECT TOP 20
  c.concept_name AS cancer_diagnosis,
  COUNT(*) AS condition_occurrences,
  COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS patients
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
JOIN smokers s ON co.person_id = s.person_id
JOIN cancer_desc cd ON co.condition_concept_id = cd.concept_id
JOIN omop.concept c ON co.condition_concept_id = c.concept_id
WHERE co.condition_start_date >= DATEADD(year, -2, CAST(GETDATE() AS date))
GROUP BY c.concept_name
ORDER BY patients DESC, condition_occurrences DESC, c.concept_name
